title: Patient arrested for sexually harassing lady doctor
byline: A patient undergoing treatment at the Nagoda General Hospital in Kalutara was arrested yesterday (14) by the Kalutara South Police for allegedly sexually harassing a female doctor on duty.

title: Japan PM pledges $10 bil. in financial aid to Asia to tackle oil shortage
byline: The Japanese government said Wednesday it will provide a total of $10 billion in financial support to other Asian nations to help them secure crude oil supplies as prices soar amid the Middle East conflict, aiming to ensure that petroleum-derived products made in those countries keep flowing into Japan.

title: Chinese ship fails to break US blockade, turns back to Hormuz after brief win
byline: A US-sanctioned tanker linked to China changed course after sailing out of the Strait of Hormuz, where vessel movements are being closely watched following a naval blockade announced by Donald Trump. According to a Reuters report, the vessel. Rich Starry, made its way back to the Strait of Hormuz as it failed to break through the US blockade.

title: UN watchdog says North Korea is boosting nuclear weapons capacity
byline: North Korea ​has made ’’very serious’’ advances in its abilities to turn out nuclear weapons, with the probable addition of a ‌new uranium enrichment facility, as it stepped up activity at a key complex, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said on Wednesday.

title: SriLankan Airlines official, pilot clash at Bangkok airport
byline: A confrontation has reportedly taken place between a SriLankan Airlines official and the captain of flight UL403 at an airport in Bangkok, Thailand.

title: US naval blockade of Iranian ports violates ceasefire: Iran’s army
byline: The continued US naval blockade of all Iranian ports constitutes a violation of the ceasefire, said the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, Iran’s top joint military command.

title: Pakistan Super League bans Zimbabwe pacer for two years for skipping league to IPL
byline: The Pakistan Cricket Board has banned the Zimbabwe pacer Blessing Muzarabani for two years after he skipped the 2026 Pakistan Premier League and joined the Indian Premier League.

title: US military: ’locked and loaded’ to strike Iran’s power plants, energy industry if ordered
byline: The U.S. naval blockade of Iran is just an example of ’’polite’’ behavior during ‌the ongoing ceasefire and U.S. forces are ready to strike Iran’s power plants and energy industry if ordered, Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth said on Thursday.

title: Pope criticises ’tyrants’ who spend billions on wars after Trump spat
byline: Pope Leo has criticised leaders who spend billions on wars and said the world was ’’being ravaged by a handful of tyrants’’ in unusually forceful comments during a visit to Cameroon.

title: Daily Mirror back on stands from Monday
byline: Following the Sinhala and Tamil New Year holidays, the Daily Mirror wishes to inform its readers that its print edition will be back on stands from Monday, April 20.

title: Breaking Down the Israel–Iran Conflict: What We Know So Far - Day 34
byline: This guide answers the most important questions about the Israel Iran war that is unfolding right now. The United States and Israel have launched major military strikes on Iran and Iran has responded with missile attacks across the region. This is one of the most serious escalations in the Middle East in years.

title: SriLankan Airlines clarifies Bangkok airport incident, suspends Country Manager
byline: SriLankan Airlines has issued a clarification regarding an incident happened at the Bangkok airport.

title: Fabricated article falsely attributed to Daily Mirror on Ashok Pathirage is fake
byline: A fabricated article falsely attributed to the Daily Mirror is currently being circulated on social media, misleading readers.

title: Walk of Peace to traverse Sri Lanka from April 21
byline: The “Walk of Peace” pilgrimage will be held across Sri Lanka from April 21 to 28, drawing local and international attention as a major spiritual event centred on faith, compassion and coexistence.

title: ID office suspends all public services tomorrow
byline: All public services, including the One-Day Service at the Head Office and all Provincial Offices of the Department for Registration of Persons, will be suspended tomorrow (17), the Department for Registration of Persons announced today.

title: Former MP Chandana Kathriarachchi arrested
byline: Former Member of Parliament Chandana Kathriarachchi has been arrested by the Colombo Crime Division after firearms-related items were discovered at his residence in Piliyandala, police said.

title: US-Iran talks expected soon, peace in Lebanon essential: Pakistan
byline: The US and Iran are willing to hold talks again soon, but there is no information yet on the venue or date for a second round, Pakistan’s Foreign Ministry says.

title: 44 killed in road accidents during festive period
byline: A total of 44 people died in road accidents reported across the island between April 10 and 15, police said.

title: Singapore Zoo’s first Sri Lankan leopard cubs make their public debut
byline: Three Sri Lankan leopard cubs that were born at the Singapore Zoo on Jan 1 have now made their public debut at the facility.

title: Severe lightning advisory issued for several areas
byline: The Department of Meteorology issued an advisory for severe lightning for the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and Uva Provinces and the Galle, Matara and Kurunegala districts after 1.00 p.m today.

title: Grounded jets threat as fuel supplies dwindle
byline: Al Jazeera- The closure of the Strait of Hormuz due to the US-Israel war on Iran has triggered a growing jet fuel crisis, with experts warning of “systemic” shortages by May or June.

title: Pakistan announces power cuts in bid to control energy prices
byline: Pakistan will suspend electricity supply for about two hours during peak-usage times every evening, the government said, in an effort to manage energy prices affected by the Iran war.

title: Donald Trump, Netanyahu, Mamdani, Xi Jinping among 100 most influential people
byline: The TIME Magazine has released its much-anticipated annual TIME100 list, featuring the 100 people shaping the world right now. The 2026 list is a mix of political heavyweights, cultural icons, and rising global voices.

title: Sri Lanka pays record $286 per barrel amid global oil price distortion
byline: Sri Lanka has paid as much as $286 for a single barrel of oil — far above global benchmark prices — according to a top international banker.

title: El Salvador publishes law allowing life sentences for minors as young as 12
byline: El Salvador has published a new law that will allow authorities to penalise minors as young as 12 with life imprisonment for severe crimes, including homicide, terrorism or rape.

title: CNH reagent scandal probe delay “suspicious” – Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa
byline: The delay in the investigation initiated by the Bribery Commission and the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) regarding the audit inquiry issued regarding the tests carried out using expired reagents in the laboratories of the Colombo National Hospital (CNH) in the past is suspicious, the Doctors’ Trade Union Alliance for Medical and Civil Rights Chairman Dr. Chamal Sanjeewa said.

title: FIFA President Gianni Infantino confirms Iran will play in the 2026 World Cup
byline: FIFA President Gianni Infantino confirmed on April 15, 2026, that Iran will take part in the 2026 World Cup, with group matches scheduled in the United States despite tighter entry rules for Iranian nationals and an elevated security backdrop around the tournament.

title: Chinese nationals caught with concealed tech equipment at BIA
byline: Sri Lanka Customs officers at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) in Katunayake have arrested nine Chinese nationals on suspicion of entering the country to engage in computer-related financial crimes.

title: Trump hails first Israel-Lebanon talks in ’34 years’, Hezbollah hints at ceasefire
byline: Israel has indicated it will continue its military campaign in Lebanon even as diplomatic efforts gain traction, with Hezbollah signalling openness to discussions tied to a possible ceasefire framework.

title: Patient remanded over alleged sexual assault of doctor at Nagoda Hospital
byline: The Acting Magistrate of Kalutara, Bandula Weerasinghe, yesterday (15) ordered that a patient accused of sexually assaulting a female doctor at the Nagoda Teaching Hospital be remanded until April 27.

title: U.S. Embassy issues warning to visitors against abusing public benefits
byline: The U.S. Embassy in Sri Lanka has issued a notice to foreign nationals planning to travel to the United States, warning that misuse of taxpayer-funded public benefits could result in serious legal and immigration consequences.

title: US Senate Republicans back Trump military sales to Israel
byline: The U.S. Senate on Wednesday blocked two resolutions that would have stopped the sale ‌of some $450 million in bombs and bulldozers to Israel, as President Donald Trump’s fellow Republicans rallied behind his support for the Jewish state.

title: Pakistan army chief in Tehran to advance next round of US-Iran talks
byline: A high-level Pakistani delegation has travelled to Iran to hold talks focused on arranging a fresh round of negotiations between Iran and the United States, a week before their fragile truce is due to expire.

title: US naval blockade of Iranian ports violates ceasefire: Iran’s army
byline: The continued US naval blockade of all Iranian ports constitutes a violation of the ceasefire, said the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, Iran’s top joint military command.

title: Israel, Lebanon agree to 10-day ceasefire, Trump says
byline: A 10-day ceasefire deal between Israel and Lebanon was announced by U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday, six weeks into a renewed war with Hezbollah that has killed more than 2,000 people, caused widespread destruction and driven more than a million residents from their homes.

title: Lebanon president thanks Trump for efforts to achieve ceasefire
byline: Lebanon’s President Joseph Aoun has thanked the US president for his efforts to “secure lasting peace and stability”, his office said on X after a phone call between the two leaders.

title: Tragedy at Deduru Oya: Two dead, six missing as group of 15 swept away
byline: A tragic drowning incident at the Deduru Oya in the Kuratiyagahamula area of Kobeigane has left at least two people dead and six others missing.

title: WhatsApp of former Bishop of Badulla hacked
byline: The WhatsApp account of the former Bishop of Badulla Rev. Winston Fernando has been hacked.

title: CPC refutes $286 per barrel claim, threatens legal action
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has firmly denied claims that Sri Lanka paid $286 per barrel for crude oil, describing the reports as false and misleading, and warning of legal action against those responsible.

title: Water shortage in some areas due to government’s decision to go for hydro power generation
byline: Some areas are facing a water shortage as a result of the government’s decision to use the water in the main reservoirs for power generation, Frontline Socialist Party (FSP) alleged.

title: CSE Rebounds Strongly as Investor Confidence Returns Amid Improved Market Outlook
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange witnessed a notable recovery on 16th April 2026, as improved market sentiment and supportive developments drove a strong rebound in indices. From the opening bell, the market remained firmly in positive territory, with sustained buying interest throughout the session helping to maintain upward momentum.
